headline: Executive session to discuss contract negotiations for the Interim Superintendent position.
summary: The School Committee will meet in executive session to discuss strategy for negotiations or contract talks with nonunion personnel regarding the Interim Superintendent. The session is not televised or recorded.
items: Executive Session: strategy sessions and contract negotiations with nonunion personnel for Interim Superintendent position, pursuant to M.G.L. c. 30A, Section 21(a)(2)
location: Media Center, Methuen High School, 1 Ranger Road, Methuen, MA
